title: Comparative Evaluation of Anti-Inflammatory - ProQuest
abstract: The study aimed to evaluate the anti-inflammatory activity of curcuminoids and oil-free aqueous extract (COFAE) of *Curcuma longa* and compare it with curcuminoids and turmerones. The anti-inflammatory activity was assessed using xylene-induced ear edema in mice and the cotton pellet granuloma model in rats. The results indicated that COFAE of *C. longa* demonstrated significant anti-inflammatory effects in both acute and chronic inflammation models, comparable to the effects of curcuminoids and turmerones.
